    Poset spaces as injective diagrams on the augmented boundary #

    The augmented boundary is a root adjoined below OrderDual T. A T-space gives a contravariant diagram on this boundary: its value at the root is the ambient vector space, its value at t is the distinguished subspace at t, and every structure map into the root is the subtype inclusion.

    This file proves the converse. A finite-dimensional boundary diagram whose maps into the root are injective is recovered by taking their ranges in the root. Thus finite T-spaces are equivalent to precisely these diagrams.
